metadata.mechanics:
Upon completion, participants gain Disease - Stage 2 Radiation Rot (or 1 higher if Target already has Radiation Rot at a higher level). In addition they gain "Upsurge: Reduce Radiation Damage by 5 to a Minimum of 1" 

After the ritual, both the target and performer must visit the Public Works and roll a 6-sided die and gain the corresponding Lineage core advantages for 4 hours as well as counting as both your existing Lineage and the rolled Lineage at the same time for the purposes of other effects. Re-roll if you get your own Lineage:
1 Devoted, 2 Evolved, 3 Gorger, 4 Landsman, 5 Mutant, 6 Townie.
metadata.requirementsToUse: Lore: Faith - Common OR Profession: Saint. User must be Inducted to the Church of Darwin
metadata.validTargetDescription: 1 Willing Target Inducted to the Church of Darwin AND Self
metadata.locationOfUse: Consecrated Space dedicated to the Church of Darwin
metadata.descriptionOfRoleplay: 10 minutes of role-play where Targets are subjected to sources of radiation, such as handling irradiated objects or proximity near glowing artifact while engaging in activities that represent extreme physical exertion and pushing their body and mind to its outer limit. The user of this benediction guides the focus of the process of medically manipulating portions of the body specific to the Target's Strain.
